items.q: How do I start an order?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the product you're looking for. We'll ask a few questions and start sourcing right away.

items.q: Can I get samples before a bulk order?
items.a: Yes — we arrange paid samples so you can check quality and fit before committing to a larger order.
We use structured, step-by-step payment handling so funds are only released as agreed milestones are met.

items.q: Do you inspect products before shipping?
items.a: Yes, every order goes through a product inspection before it's cleared for shipping.
We offer both small parcel shipping for samples and low-volume orders, and full door-to-door freight for bulk orders.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We currently ship from China & Hong Kong to Hong Kong, India, and South Africa, with more regions being added.

about.title: Connecting You to China's Best Factories
about.subtitle: We bridge the gap between international buyers and verified Chinese manufacturers — with transparency, inspection, and trust at every step.
about.story: The Unique Choice was founded to solve a simple problem: sourcing from China shouldn't require a plane ticket or a leap of faith. We built a network of verified factories and suppliers across mainland China and Hong Kong, combined it with hands-on inspection, and wrapped it in a transparent, step-by-step process.
about.mission: Our mission is to make international sourcing accessible, safe, and efficient for businesses of every size — from first-time buyers to established brands.

values.title: Verification First
values.desc: Every supplier we work with is personally vetted. We don't list factories we haven't inspected.

values.title: Full Transparency
values.desc: Photos, reports, and updates at every stage. You always know what's happening with your order.

values.title: Secure Handling
values.desc: Structured payments and protected shipping so your money and products are always safe.

about.regions: We operate across mainland China and Hong Kong, connecting buyers to factories in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Yiwu, and beyond.
about.founderBio: Vishal Saini founded The Unique Choice after years of firsthand experience navigating factories, trade shows, and shipping routes across mainland China and Hong Kong. He works directly with every client to make sure sourcing feels less like a gamble and more like a partnership.
